Commentary.Commentary: Right! That's all from this game and the ODI series. It ends with 3-0. Before this, the hosts pouched the T20I series 2-1. Now, the action will move to the longest format of the game. The first Test match begins on 21st March. The action will start at 1000 local (1400 GMT). We will look for your company then. For now, it is goodbye from our end.

Kieron Pollard, the winning skipper chats now. He smiles and says that he is pleased with the result. Says that it has been hard work for them. Tells that the guys at the top have done a superb job for them and have allowed the middle order to come into the game. Says that their batters were not happy with him when he opted to bat first but adds that they are now happy as they have won the series. Adds that they knew if they can take early wickets, they can restrict the opposition. Mentions that it was a complete team effort from them. Says that he wants the team to keep playing well and keep improving. On their new Test skipper, Pollard says that he wishes him lots of luck and wants the management to back him. Adds that Holder did a superb job as a skipper too.

Dimuth Karunaratne, the Sri Lankan skipper is in for a chat. Tells that they would've bowled first if the toss had gone their way. Tells that the ball wasn't coming well during the first innings. Says that they kept losing wickets at crucial times and that didn't help their cause. Praises the performance of Hope, Lewis and Bravo. Mentions that they have learnt a lot from this series. Says that Tests will be different than these games and their players are shaping well for that series. Ends by saying that they are looking forward to the Test series.

Shai Hope wins the Player of the Series! Hope starts by saying that it means a lot. Tells that it is special as he has contributed to the victory. Says that his job is to score runs and take the team to a good position. On his 6th 50-plus score in a row, Hope says that it is their job and if he can continue doing that, he will love it. Says that the guys are working really hard on and off the field and is pleased to have got the reward.

Darren Bravo is named Player of the Match for his superb century. Bravo tells that this was an important game for him. Dedicates the knock to his sister who celebrates her birthday. Adds that in the team meetings, they chalked out plans and it worked. Says that he tries to give himself the opportunity to bat long and feels that if he stays in the middle, runs will come. Ends by saying that he enjoys batting alongside Hope.

Earlier in the game, West Indies won the toss and asked Sri Lanka to set a target. The Lankans were off to a fine start but they struggled in the middle overs and kept losing wickets at regular intervals. Their batters got starts but failed to get going. They lost their 6 wickets for 151 in the 32nd over. It looked like West Indies will stop Sri Lanka to a very low score but Hasaranga along with Bandara made sure that wasn't the case as the duo added a 100-plus stand to take the team over 270. Hasaranga scored 60-ball 80 and hit 7 boundaries and 3 biggies in the process. Hosein got 3 wickets to his name and he was the pick of the bowler for the hosts. The West Indians gave away a little too many in the death overs. However, their performance in the first half of the innings meant that Sri Lanka couldn't post a massive total and on the back of fine batting performance, West Indies have managed to stroll to a victory.

Sri Lankans failed to be consistent with the ball. The West Indian batters didn't allow them to settle in a rhythm throughout the chase. They played the spell of spinners calmly and punished the poor balls. The Lankans failed to strike regularly and that didn't help their cause.

Chasing the score, West Indies lost last game's centurion, Lewis early. Mohammed didn't last long either. However, after that, Hope along with Bravo added a 100-plus stand as the duo raked up their half-centuries. Hope got out but Bravo continued. Bravo was a bit slow in his approach but he kept finding the boundaries every now and then. Along with skipper Pollard, Bravo stitched another stand and helped the team get close to the victory. Bravo fell after getting to his century but Pollard played his part till the end and took the team over the line.

Clinical run chase from West Indies and they wrap up the ODI series 3-0. Brilliant performance from the Men in Maroon. At no point, it looked like West Indies were out of this game. Their batters just made sure the asking rate never went out of their reach and with quality hitters like Pollard and Holder in their ranks, it was an easy win for them in the end.
SIX! And here's that hit. Mighty blow from Holder. Fuller ball on middle and leg, Holder powers it over deep mid-wicket to seal the deal. West Indies win by 5 wickets.

EDGED AND FOUR! Unlucky for the bowler and Sri Lanka but Holder won't care. A slower length ball outside off, Holder makes room and looks to slog it on the leg side. He ends up getting a thick outside edge. The ball goes to the right side of the keeper. He dives that side but fails to get to the ball. West Indies just a hit away.
Good yorker on the pads, Holder cannot dig it out.

Just a single off the Free Hit. Fernando nails the yorker. Holder can only hit it to long on for one. A decent over from Asitha so far. Can he get a wicket on the last ball to end it on a high?

Dot to end the 10th over. A successful one for Sri Lanka. Another googly. Hope reads it well and tucks it towards mid-wicket off the back foot. 235 needed in 240 balls.
Darted short and around middle, punched to long on for one by Bravo to open his account.
Fuller and around middle, played back to the bowler.
Darren Bravo replaces Jason Mohammed.

OUT! TIMBER! The googly from Hasaranga and it is too good for Jason. Lovely bit of bowling from him. He tosses it up and lands it around off, Mohammed comes on the front foot and looks to defend. However, the wrong' un lands and turns in. The ball sneaks through the little gap between the bat and pad. The stumps behind gets shaken up.
Good stop! Full and wide outside off, Hope drives it superbly but Bandara makes an excellent dive to his left to stop the ball.
Flat and around off, played back to the bowler.
Short again and around off again. Punched to mid off this time. 8 off the 9th over.
Shortish and around off, played back to the bowler.

FOUR! Lovely drive down the ground. Shot of the day? Mohammed enjoyed it for sure as he kept the pose for the cameras. A length ball around off, Jason drives the ball on the up and through mid on. Super shot.
Nicely driven! Full and wide outside off, Mohammed drives it through the covers and scampers back for two.
Around middle on a good length, flicked through square leg for one.
Short and wide outside off, Jason looks to cut but ends up getting a thick outside edge. The ball goes wide of the slip fielder. A single as third man gets to the ball.
Dargged it short and outside off, Hope misses out as he pulls it off the toe end. Finds mid-wicket. Just 1 off the over.
Floated on middle, played back to the bowler.
Flat and around middle, punched to mid on for nothing.
Jason is up and running on the 7th ball. Tossed up and outside off, eased through mid off for a single.
Short and just around off, Mohammed rocks back and cuts. Finds backward point.
Tossed up and around middle, the first ball from Hasaranga. It is pushed back to him.
Time for spin. Here's Wanindu Hasaranga with the ball. Did the job with the willow.
Yes, he can! Length and around off, Hope pushes it towards mid on. Lovely over from Lakmal.
Wide outside off, pushed to mid off. Another dot. Can Lakmal bowl a maiden?
4 dots in a row! Another length ball around off, worked to mid-wicket for nothing.
Around off on a length, pushed to mid on and a loud no for the run.

Full toss around off, Hope drills it back to the bowler who gets down to stop with his right hand. He gets a hand to it and then the ball goes to hit the stumps at the non-striker's end. Mohammed though kept his bat grounded inside the crease. No damage done.
Shortish and just around off, punched on the off side for nothing.
Dot to end the over! Length ball around off, blocked off the back foot.
Good length and around off, poked to mid-wicket for nothing.
Short and wide outside off, Mohammed crunches it wide of the point fielder who dives to his right and keeps Jason on zero.
Around off on a length, this one comes back in. Jason looks to work it on the leg side but ends up getting an inside edge on the pad.
Good length and around middle, Hope looks to tuck it around the corner but ends up getting an outside edge. The ball goes to third man for one.
Fine leg comes inside the circle.
FOUR! Classic from Hope! A length ball outside off, Hope punches the drive through the covers. The ball races to the fence in the deep. That was off the middle of the willow.
Jason Mohammed walks in at no. 3.

OUT! TIMBER! Terrific ball and the sticks behind are rattled. Lovely set up from Lakmal. Huge wicket for Sri Lanka. Lakmal bowls a length ball around middle, it lands and moves away. Lewis looks to defend but he plays the wrong line this time. Misses to see the woodwork behind get disturbed.
FOUR! Just a push but it races to the fence. Lakmal went for the yorker but failed to get it right. A low full toss on middle, Lewis strokes it through mid on and finds the fence.
Length delivery on off, Lewis drives it to point.
Full on middle, Hope flicks it through square leg for a run.
Full on off, Lewis drives it through point for a single.
Back of a length on off, Lewis defends it out.
Short delivery on off, Hope defends it off the back foot.
Good length delivery on off, Hope defends it off the back foot.
FOUR! Classic shot! Full on middle, Hope drives it past the bowler through mid on for a boundary.
Length ball on off, Hope guides it to gully.
Back of a length on off, Hope pushes it towards covers for a single. The fielder goes for a direct hit at the keeper's end but misses it. It goes for overthrows. The batsmen take an extra run.
Full on off, Hope drives it to mid off.
Full again on middle, Hope flicks it through square leg for a single.
Full on middle, Hope flicks it through mid-wicket. The batsmen get two runs.
Length ball on off, Hope pushes it to point.
Back of a length on middle, Hope pushes it to mid on.
Length delivery on off, Hope defends it off the back foot.
Back of a length on off, Hope defends it to point.
Good length ball on off, Lewis defends it off the back foot.
Length delivery on middle, Lewis flicks it through square leg for a couple.
Full on middle, Lewis pushes it to mid on.
FOUR! Terrific shot! Full on off, Lewis drives it beautifully through covers for a boundary.
Full toss on off, Lewis drives it to covers.
Full on off, Hope drives it through covers for a single.
Asitha Fernando to bowl from the other end.
Back of a length on off, Lewis pushes it to covers. 2 runs from the first over!
Full on middle, Lewis pushes it to mid on.
Length delivery outside off, Lewis offers no shot to this one.
Good length ball outside off, Lewis shoulders arms to it.
Back of a length on middle, Lewis flicks it through square leg. The batsmen get two runs.
Lakmal starts with a length delivery on off, Lewis pushes it to point.
